brief:
Shehab Wire reported that food supply inspectors in Khan Yunis governorate destroyed approximately 16.8 tons of frozen spoiled chicken in coordination with relevant authorities from the health and national economy ministries.

The operation targeted contaminated poultry stock identified during inspections in the southern Gaza territory. Officials from multiple government agencies participated in the destruction to prevent the compromised meat from entering local markets.
